cs.t: I despise it as a workspace as well.  Some people don't mind as much, but I haven't met anyone that's openly enthusiastic about it. I got a pair of Etymotic In-Ear Headphones[0] which have kept me sane for several years now.  They have interchangeable tips with a NRR on-par with foam plugs.  Worth every penny in an open office.
